name: "DonutButBetter"
description:
DonutButBetter: everything you liked about DonutSMP, without what you hated.

Live economy: /sell prices follow supply and demand. Farm what others don't and get rich. Auction house, buy orders, safe /trade and a server auction.

Free shards: earn them in the AFK zone and from PvP kills. Spend them in /shardshop and on crates. No paying for shards.

Lag-free spawners that only drop loot, so the server stays smooth.

Huge survival world: 200k-block border, free /rtp with no cooldown, homes, teams, friends, parties and bounties.

Fair play: our own anticheat, anti-xray and anti-ESP to stop base finders, plus active staff.

Cosmetics: nicknames with colours and fonts, titles, tags and skins.

A custom spawn island with music and live leaderboards.

No pay-to-win subscriptions: ranks are cheap one-time perks, and the starter rank is free.

Bedrock and Java both welcome (1.21). Join the Discord for events and updates: https://discord.gg/PJrbyckAGG

Bedrock: 76.164.199.237 port 19132

Java: 76.164.199.237 port 25565
